content: Supabase drift: 'supabase db diff --linked' runs migra against a shadow DB built from supabase/migrations to produce a drift diff. 'supabase migration list' compares local vs remote history; 'supabase migration repair' fixes history mismatch. When history is unsalvageable, 'supabase db dump' a baseline migration, clear supabase_migrations.schema_migrations, push baseline. Types: 'supabase gen types typescript' regenerated in CI and diffed to fail build on drift.
